definitions.explanation: An aromatic herb in the mint family, widely used in Japanese cuisine. The leaves have a distinctive flavor that is fresh, slightly minty, and herbaceous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧シソ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{添|そ}えてある→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: Shiso is served alongside the sashimi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧シソ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I grow shiso in the garden and use it in cooking.

notes:
Also written as {紫蘇|しそ} in kanji, but the katakana シソ is common.

TYPES:
- ⟦{青|あお}じそ→青じそ：20831_aojiso⟧ (⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧): green shiso, the most common variety used as a garnish and in cooking
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧じそ: red shiso, used for making ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧ and shiso juice

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シソ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: shiso leaves
- ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧: green shiso leaf (common name in supermarkets)
- シソジュース: shiso juice (made from red shiso)
- シソ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: shiso tempura

USAGE:
In supermarkets and recipes, green shiso is often sold under the name ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧ rather than シソ. The two terms refer to the same thing, but ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧ specifically means the leaf when used as food.
